picks.editorial_note: An international team led by RWTH Aachen published HydroGym, an open-source reinforcement-learning platform for controlling fluid dynamics, in Nature — a peer-reviewed breakthrough with direct applications spanning energy, transportation, and defense systems.
picks.title: Training AI Agents that Can Actively Control Fluid Dynamics in Energy, Transportation, and Defense | RWTH Aachen University | EN

picks.editorial_note: Imperial College London and Thomson Reuters built a $40 million frontier AI model by fine-tuning an open-source base, offering a lower-cost blueprint for 'sovereign AI' that could reshape how nations and enterprises approach frontier model development.
picks.title: Imperial and Thomson Reuters pioneer new technical approach that could broaden access to sovereign AI

picks.editorial_note: EPFL researchers developed a framework enabling LLMs to express calibrated uncertainty when proposing experiments, a methodological advance that could meaningfully accelerate AI-driven scientific discovery across disciplines.
picks.title: An AI capable of doubt can optimize scientific discovery

picks.editorial_note: A $7.7 million, multi-year partnership between Kansas engineers, the Army Corps of Engineers, and DHS is applying AI digital-twin technology to inspect and strengthen America's dam infrastructure — a direct national-security and public-safety application.
picks.title: Four years later KU researchers continue their work strengthening American dams

picks.editorial_note: A DOE-funded $2.88 million University of Houston-led project applies AI to secure America's critical mineral and rare-earth-magnet supply chain, addressing a strategic vulnerability tied to foreign dependence.
picks.title: Department of Energy Awards UH-led Team $2.88M to Use AI to Strengthen America’s Critical Mineral Supply Chain | University of Houston

picks.editorial_note: UNSW Canberra opened major new robotics and drone testing infrastructure, including one of Australia's largest indoor test arenas, expanding national capacity for autonomous systems research and defense-relevant AI.
picks.title: New facilities expand innovation ecosystem at UNSW Canberra City

picks.editorial_note: UT Austin's new fusion energy seed grants tie into DOE's Genesis Mission to apply AI toward accelerating fusion research, reflecting a significant federal push to fuse AI with the energy transition.
picks.title: Fusion Energy Seed Grants Launch New Interdisciplinary Collaborations at UT Austin - UT News
picks.university: The University of Texas at Austin

picks.editorial_note: A DOE Genesis Mission-funded Kent State project is building an AI framework from 50 years of national water-chemistry data to enable continental-scale environmental prediction, part of a broader federal AI-for-science initiative.
picks.title: Streams Never Lie; Kent State Magazine; Fall 2026

picks.editorial_note: A $40 million U.S. Department of Labor grant led by Jobs for the Future, with University of Cincinnati as a partner, expands apprenticeships in AI and semiconductor-adjacent trades, addressing the AI workforce pipeline at national scale.
picks.title: Major grant expands apprenticeship opportunities at UC

picks.editorial_note: SRI spinout Latent AI's edge-inference platform substantially compresses neural networks for deployment across diverse edge hardware, a practical advance for real-world AI deployment in resource-constrained settings.
picks.title: Case study: Edge AI deployment gets simpler with Latent AI - SRI
